description:
Interprocedural lite for the raw-slot verdicts: (a) callee→caller — classify each named sub's return family (every return/tail expr through _tw_shape_ok's family oracle; explicit + implicit returns); record in sub_info pre-pass; a call-site write `my $x = f()` with returns=>'num'/'str' becomes a PROVEN family write (plain raw, no strict freeze). (b) caller→callee — transfer param use-classes to call-site args so f($q) need not be opaque. Same closed-world invalidation rules as direct-call sub_info: no methods/coderefs/AUTOLOAD/wantarray-sensitive; bail on glob redefinition. USER note s303: simple cases should be simple. Blocked on: E2-E4 completion (user directive).

HALF (a) SHIPPED s461aq (round 18) as Kind-A `raw-return-family`; half (b)
(caller->callee param use-class transfer) NOT started.

WHAT SHIPPED.  `Parser2::_sub_return_facts` replaces `_sub_ctx_insensitive`:
ONE walk over every value a named sub can return (each `return EXPR` plus the
implicit tail), from ONE analysis parse, answering BOTH facts â `insensitive`
(unchanged, byte-identical conditions) and `returns` ('num'/'str' when every
return is proven and they agree).  The oracle is VarAnnotator's OWN
(`value_family` -> `_tw_shape_ok`), so the proof licensing `$x = $a + $b` and
the proof licensing `$x = f()` are literally the same proof; the funcall-root
arm of `_tw_shape_ok` now consults `known_subs{$f}{returns}`.  sub_info
carries `returns` only when proven (absent = no proof).  The pre-pass asks
the oracle with an EMPTY call table so a sub's family cannot depend on where
in the file the subs it calls are defined.

TWO BUGS FOUND ON THE WAY, both PRE-EXISTING, both fixed here because #77
would have transferred them:
 1. `_tw_shape_ok` called unary PLUS 'num'.  perl's unary plus is a NO-OP, so
    `+$y` IS `$y` â a BOX â and `my $b = +$h; $h = 77;` then read 77 where
    perl reads 5 (probed; wrong on HEAD too).  It is value-TRANSPARENT now
    (takes its operand's shape).  `-` and `!` still compute (#921 has the
    `-$str` label residue).
 2. Parser2's native token split DECLINES a statement with a depth-0 operator
    below assignment precedence and routes it through the seam, where the
    write is a box-set that CANNOT store into a raw slot â and Parser2's own
    comment said an unboxable name "cannot be stranded by this reroute"
    because a comma tail always sits under a funcall root, which was never a
    proven shape.  #77 made it provable and `$c = two 1, 2` stored NOTHING
    (the gate caught it: transpile-test-07.t row 23).  `_tw_stmt_expr` now
    asks the SAME predicate (`Parser2::_tail_below_assign_prec`), so the two
    native-root models agree by construction.

MEASURED.  Emission A/B (gate on vs off) over 405 lib/ + cpan files: 4 DIFF,
0 RCDIFF â Carp.pm `$i` and Test2::API::Instance `$ipc_exit` go BOXED -> raw
slot, Math::BigInt::Calc `$len` loses its `%pcl-to-number-strict` wrapper,
and Test2::EventFacet::Info::Table `$out` goes raw -> boxed (that one is the
unary-plus fix withdrawing a false claim).  corpus-diff over the 111-file
perl-tests corpus: IDENTICAL.  Per-shape bench, A/B on one tree via PCL_OPT,
8e6 calls: `my $x = calc($i); $s = $s + $x` 0.3727 s -> 0.2809 s, **24.6 %
faster** (the freeze wrapper is gone).  The opposite direction exists and is
filed as #922: when the slot's value is used as a HASH KEY, a raw slot is
9.9 % SLOWER than a boxed one because a box caches its string form â a
property of the raw-slot verdict generally, not of this transfer.

BARS: gate PASS 191/6462 (19 new guard rows); full sweep GATE clean TOTAL
18342 (+0) drops 5 = census; gate-SET scan 638 files x 2 populations
IDENTICAL; companion op/ --quick, 221 files, zero real movers (28 sig-only
diffs, every one reproduced on the base tree or a worktree-path artifact);
PCL_OPT=-raw-return-family byte-identical to the base compiler and
PCL_OPT=none identical on both; 14-row probe battery vs perl 5.40.3 (13
identical; row 10 is #920, pre-existing).  Guards: 17 rows in
Pl/t/raw-verdict-01.t incl. 8 negatives (bare-variable return, mixed
families, bare `return;`, conditional tail, compound tail, unknown sub,
method call, below-assignment tail) and the PCL_OPT-off row.
subject: Perf: return-family transfer through sub_info (post-E4)
